Subject: KMS/HSM evidence request & walkthrough

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for taking our SIG questionnaire. The Digera security team has a few follow-ups specific to encryption and key management that we need for our internal risk review and SOC 2 track:

- Signed HSM attestation for the cluster serving the Digera tenancy (device serial and attestation expiry).
- Key rotation manifest showing rotation cadence, last rotation timestamp, and owner for each KEK/DEK in scope.
- Operator shift logs (last quarter) for HSM/KMS personnel who had key custodial privileges.
- Access matrix showing which Redwood roles can unwrap/wrap versus invoke-only.
- A short walkthrough (30–45m) where you can show how rotating a key looks in your console and where archived materials live.

Can you confirm whether you can provide the PDFs and CSV exports above, and give 2–3 time options for a walkthrough next week? Also let us know if you need a signed NDA/PSA before we accept the artifacts.

Appreciate it — we’re trying to close the Digera risk gap card by 2/24.

Best,
Ava Singh
Manager, Information Security
Digera Inc.
